# `m.reference.news`

<!-- Generated by `uv run python scripts/render_reference.py`; do not edit by hand. -->

News articles about tickers, with their publishers and sentiment insights.

```python
m.reference.news(symbols=None, *, start=None, end=None, sort=None, order=None, limit=None, filters=None)
```

[All datasets](README.md)

|  |  |
| --- | --- |
| Verbs | `fetch()`, `poll()` |
| Served by | REST |
| Time range | `start` and `end` are sent as `published_utc.gte` and `published_utc.lt` |
| `poll()` | `dm.PollMode.APPEND`: appends only rows it has not seen, keyed by `Id` and `Symbol` |
| `sort` | `published_utc` |
| `filters` | `ticker_gt`, `ticker_gte`, `ticker_lt`, `ticker_lte` |

## Plan access

Which of Massive's plans include this dataset, how recent its data is on each, and how far back its history goes, as Massive's pages state them.

| Plan | News (REST) |
| --- | --- |
| Stocks Basic | Updated hourly, 2 years |
| Stocks Starter | Updated hourly, All history |
| Stocks Developer | Updated hourly, All history |
| Stocks Advanced | Updated hourly, All history |
| Stocks Business | Updated hourly, All history |

## Columns

| Column | Deephaven type | Description | Supplied by |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Symbol` | String | The ticker the request named that the row lists in `Tickers`: a row that lists several of the named tickers appears once for each, so an article about AAPL and MSFT read for both is listed under each. A request that named one ticker gives it to every row. Null when the call named no ticker, and on a row that lists none of a request's named tickers. | REST |
| `AmpUrl` | String | The mobile friendly Accelerated Mobile Page (AMP) URL. | REST |
| `ArticleUrl` | String | A link to the news article. | REST |
| `Author` | String | The article's author. | REST |
| `Description` | String | A description of the article. | REST |
| `Id` | String | Unique identifier for the article. | REST |
| `ImageUrl` | String | The article's image URL. | REST |
| `Insights` | String | The insights related to the article. The column holds Massive's value as JSON text. | REST |
| `Keywords` | String[] | The keywords associated with the article (which will vary depending on the publishing source). | REST |
| `PublishedUtc` | Instant | The UTC date and time when the article was published, formatted in RFC3339 standard (e.g. YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ). | REST |
| `PublisherFaviconUrl` | String | The publisher's homepage favicon URL. From the `publisher` object: Details the source of the news article, including the publisher's name, logo, and homepage URLs. This information helps users identify and access the original source of news content. | REST |
| `PublisherHomepageUrl` | String | The publisher's homepage URL. From the `publisher` object: Details the source of the news article, including the publisher's name, logo, and homepage URLs. This information helps users identify and access the original source of news content. | REST |
| `PublisherLogoUrl` | String | The publisher's logo URL. From the `publisher` object: Details the source of the news article, including the publisher's name, logo, and homepage URLs. This information helps users identify and access the original source of news content. | REST |
| `PublisherName` | String | The publisher's name. From the `publisher` object: Details the source of the news article, including the publisher's name, logo, and homepage URLs. This information helps users identify and access the original source of news content. | REST |
| `Tickers` | String[] | The ticker symbols associated with the article. | REST |
| `Title` | String | The title of the news article. | REST |
| `TimestampInsert` | Instant | When the library received the row, as an Instant: the local clock when the REST page, flat-file block, or WebSocket frame that carried it arrived, the same for every row of one. It is not monotonic and is not Massive's own receive time; on history() rows it is the download time, and in a poll() table the latest poll's. | REST |
